description: This Java source file defines the 'Index' class, which models a MongoDB index with various properties such as keys, name, uniqueness, sparseness, background creation, partial filter expressions, and expiration settings. It provides methods for constructing index instances, converting to MongoDB driver models, and managing index attributes.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Represents a MongoDB index configuration with properties for keys, name, indexing options, and expiration settings. Provides mechanisms for creating, modifying, and converting index instances for use with MongoDB Java driver.

methods.name: Index.of
methods.description: Creates a new Index instance with specified keys, name, and options such as uniqueness, sparseness, and background creation.

methods.name: Index.indexInfoOf
methods.description: Constructs an Index object from a MongoDB Document, extracting index configuration details.

methods.name: Index.withExpireAfterSeconds
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current Index with an expiration time set in seconds.

methods.name: Index.withPartialFilterExpression
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current Index with an updated partial filter expression.

methods.name: Index.toIndexModel
methods.description: Converts this Index into an IndexModel suitable for MongoDB driver operations.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the BSON document representing the index keys.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the index.

methods.name: isUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether the index enforces uniqueness.

methods.name: isSparse
methods.description: Indicates whether the index is sparse.

methods.name: isBackground
methods.description: Indicates whether the index is created in the background.

methods.name: getExpireAfterSeconds
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the expiration time in seconds, if set.
